opportunities.title: Small grants

amount.raw: Awards generally fall in a range of £1,500-£5,000 and will only exceptionally exceed £6,000. Travel awards up to £2,000 per person for trips up to 13 days, £2,500 for 14+ days; PhD fieldwork visits up to £5,000. Japan office up to ¥300,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution willing to receive grant funds. Applications not accepted from individuals for personal projects. UK projects apply to UK office, Japan projects to Japan office.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding to enable UK-Japan projects that deepen mutual understanding and encourage exchange of ideas or expertise across any field including arts and culture, humanities and social issues, Japanese language, medicine and health, science, youth and education, and sport. Supports festivals, workshops, exchanges, collaborative projects, Japanese language teaching, and academic research/visits.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: Up to £10,000 per year; continuing projects lasting up to three years to a maximum of £10,000 per year, to a total limit of £30,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally be able to show an existing research record; consideration also given to practitioners, managers, carers or others in health-related fields. Project must involve partners in both the UK and Japan. Preference to those not previously involved in UK-Japan collaboration and early-career applicants. Apply to the London office.
opportunities.summary: Supports exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, including study of scientific, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare. Grants may be used for travel expenses or to contribute to other costs including conference and publication costs.
